items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: I worked there with Herbert Smith.

ctx.x: Yeah. I have been to, I think the Harmony Inn at one time used to have Wednesday nights. Yeah, that's right.
I never even worked there. Oh I did. Well I worked there years ago, the old man went in the canal in front of the door. I worked there with Herbert Smith. Remember Herbert Smith?
Remember Herbert Smith? He had saxophone.
